chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Chapter 507: Source Ancestor Wants a Disciple, But Subhuti Arrives
chapter_meta_description: Source Ancestor brutally destroys the Seamless Gate's forces and offers to take Ji Ning as a disciple! But Ji Ning's loyalty to his master Subhuti creates a deadlock. Who will win?
og_title: The Master’s Arrival – Desolate Era Chapter 507
og_description: Source Ancestor brutally destroys the Seamless Gate and offers to teach Ji Ning, but the young Sword Immortal's loyalty to his first master creates a tense standoff.
twitter_description: Ji Ning faces a dilemma when a new Daofather wants to take him as a disciple, but only if his first master approves. And then, Subhuti appears!

lore_anchors.definition: A supreme existence who has fully mastered a Grand Dao, representing the peak of power within the Three Realms. They are the true rulers of the immortal world.
The second highest grade of magic treasure in the Xianxia world, incredibly rare and powerful, below only Innate spirit-treasures.
A treasure born from primordial natural forces, possessing a spiritual nature. They can choose their own master and are harder to bind than manufactured treasures.
A secondary body created by a cultivator that possesses a fraction of the true body's power. Often used for dangerous tasks where the loss of the true body would be fatal.
A formless, metaphysical power derived from a cultivator's will and Dao-heart, distinct from Ki or Divine Power. It is the foundation of arts like archery and mental attacks.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why is Ji Ning so hesitant to take Source Ancestor as his master?
cultural_notes_faq.a: In Xianxia culture, a master is like a father, and taking a new master without the old master's permission is a form of betrayal that can poison one's Dao-heart forever.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What happened to the Diancai Immortal and Source Ancestor?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Long ago, Source Ancestor took pity on a desperate Diancai Immortal and taught him a single sword technique. The Diancai Immortal considers him his true master despite never being formally accepted.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why can Source Ancestor so easily kill the avatars of True Immortals and Empyrean Gods?
cultural_notes_faq.a: As a Daofather, Source Ancestor operates on an entirely different plane of power. Avatars, which are mere shadows of a true body, are no match for the absolute might of a Daofather's will.
